description: Enforce HyperMemory recall and delegated end-of-turn persistence in Codex.

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,re,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get("PLUGIN_ROOT"); not root and sys.exit(0); base=pathlib.Path(root).parent; candidates=[p for p in base.glob("*/scripts/hypermemory_hook.py") if p.is_file()]; script=max(candidates,key=lambda p:tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+",p.parent.parent.name)[:3]),default=None); script is None and sys.exit(0); os.environ["PLUGIN_ROOT"]=str(script.parent.parent); sys.argv=[str(script),sys.argv[1]]; runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name="__main__")' session-start

python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,re,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get("PLUGIN_ROOT"); not root and sys.exit(0); base=pathlib.Path(root).parent; candidates=[p for p in base.glob("*/scripts/hypermemory_hook.py") if p.is_file()]; script=max(candidates,key=lambda p:tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+",p.parent.parent.name)[:3]),default=None); script is None and sys.exit(0); os.environ["PLUGIN_ROOT"]=str(script.parent.parent); sys.argv=[str(script),sys.argv[1]]; runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name="__main__")' user-prompt
